annotations.title: Disconnect Ahrefs Connect from a project

description: Full disconnect: drops BOTH the Rank Tracker and Site Audit bindings and the stored grant. Breaks Ahrefs data for every member of the organization, not just the caller — requires at least the admin role.

projectId.description: Required. The MisarSEO project ID to scope this call to. Get one from list_projects.

name: disconnect_ahrefs
